$comment: How each web component is covered on iOS and Android. 'build' means a new Stance component that wraps the system control where one exists. 'map' means an existing Stance component already covers it and only the inventory link is missing. 'idiom' means the platform's own API is the right answer and the docs say so instead of shipping a wrapper.

build.accordion: StanceAccordion on DisclosureGroup with StanceDisclosureGroupStyle, single or multiple expanded
build.chart-container: StanceChart on Swift Charts: line, bar, area; ink scale series, audio graph and accessibility chart descriptor
build.checkbox-group: StanceCheckboxGroup with a label, helper, error and an optional select all
build.code-block: StanceCodeBlock: monospaced, horizontally scrollable, optional line numbers, copy action
build.copy-button: StanceCopyButton on UIPasteboard with a confirmation state and haptic
build.combobox: StanceCombobox: a field that opens a searchable list in a sheet or popover, single selection
build.multi-select: StanceMultiSelect: searchable selection of several values shown as removable tags
build.data-table: StanceDataTable on Table for regular width with a list layout for compact width, sorting and selection
build.date-range-picker: StanceDateRangePicker on MultiDatePicker or two DatePickers with a clear range summary
build.filter-chip: StanceFilterChip: a toggle chip with a checkmark, for filter rows
build.chip: StanceChip: a compact removable or tappable chip
build.tree-view: StanceTreeView on OutlineGroup / List(children:) with expand state and selection
build.inline-edit: StanceInlineEdit: a row that turns into a text field on tap, commit and cancel
build.notification: StanceNotificationRow: title, body, time, unread state, swipe actions
build.number-input: StanceNumberField: a TextField with number formatting, bounds and a system Stepper
build.pagination: StancePagination: previous, next and page summary for regular width tables
build.pin-input: StancePinField: one time code entry with .oneTimeCode content type and paste support
build.progress-circle: StanceProgressCircle on ProgressView with a circular style and value label
build.range-slider: StanceRangeSlider: two thumb slider with accessibility adjustable actions for each thumb
build.rich-text: StanceRichText: renders Markdown via AttributedString with Stance type styles, links and lists
build.sortable-list: StanceSortableList on List with onMove and EditButton
build.tabs: StanceTabs: a segmented or underline tab strip for switching views inside a screen
build.toggle-button: StanceToggleButton and StanceToggleButtonGroup with selected state

idiom.breadcrumbs: Use NavigationStack. Its back button and title carry the path.
idiom.error-boundary: SwiftUI has no render errors to catch. Model failures as state and show StanceErrorState.
idiom.floating-action-button: Put the primary action in the toolbar or a bottom bar, as iOS apps do.
idiom.hover-card: Use .popover on iPad and a sheet on iPhone.
idiom.tooltip: Use .help for pointer and the system popover for touch.
idiom.icon-gallery: Not needed on device. Browse icons on the website.
idiom.kbd: Use .keyboardShortcut so the system shows shortcuts in menus.
idiom.link: Use Link, styled by the theme tint.
idiom.menubar: Use the app's Commands, shown in the iPad menu bar.
idiom.skip-link: VoiceOver rotor and headings cover this. Mark headings with .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader).
idiom.virtualized-list: List and LazyVStack are already lazy.

build.accordion: StanceAccordion with animated expand, single or multiple expanded, heading semantics
build.collapsible: StanceCollapsible, the single section form of StanceAccordion
build.calendar: StanceCalendar: an inline month grid on Material 3 DatePicker in display mode
build.chart-container: StanceChart: line, bar and area on Canvas with ink scale series and a semantics summary plus per point traversal
build.checkbox-group: StanceCheckboxGroup with a label, helper, error and an optional select all (tri state)
build.code-block: StanceCodeBlock: monospaced, horizontally scrollable, optional line numbers, copy action
build.copy-button: StanceCopyButton on ClipboardManager with a confirmation state and haptic
build.combobox: StanceCombobox on ExposedDropdownMenuBox with an editable field and filtering
build.multi-select: StanceMultiSelect: searchable selection of several values shown as input chips
build.context-menu: Modifier.stanceContextMenu: long press opens StanceDropdownMenu at the touch point
build.tree-view: StanceTreeView: lazy, keyed, expand and collapse with semantics
build.inline-edit: StanceInlineEdit: a row that turns into a text field on tap, commit and cancel
build.notification: StanceNotificationItem: title, body, time, unread state, swipe actions
build.number-input: StanceNumberField: numeric keyboard, formatting, bounds, increment and decrement buttons
build.pagination: StancePagination: previous, next and page summary for expanded width tables
build.pin-input: StancePinField: one time code entry with autofill hints and paste support
build.popover: StancePopover on Popup with a caret, dismiss on outside tap
build.rich-text: StanceRichText: renders Markdown into AnnotatedString with Stance type styles, links and lists
build.sortable-list: StanceSortableList: drag handles and accessibility move up and move down actions
build.theme-switcher: StanceThemeSwitcher: system, light, dark and high contrast as a segmented button row
build.toolbar: StanceToolbar on the Material 3 floating toolbar

idiom.breadcrumbs: Use the top app bar's up navigation and title.
idiom.caption: Use Text with the Stance caption style from the theme.
idiom.container: Use StanceScaffold with window size classes.
idiom.error-boundary: Compose has no render errors to catch. Model failures as state and show StanceErrorState.
idiom.heading: Use Text with a Stance heading style and Modifier.semantics { heading() }.
idiom.text: Use Text with Stance type styles from the theme.
idiom.hover-card: Use StancePopover. Hover only applies with a mouse.
idiom.icon-gallery: Not needed on device. Browse icons on the website.
idiom.image: Use Image and your image loader.
idiom.kbd: Use keyboard shortcuts in the system shortcut helper.
idiom.menubar: Use the top app bar's actions and overflow menu.
idiom.resizable-panel: Use the list detail scaffold from Material 3 adaptive.
idiom.scroll-area: Use Modifier.verticalScroll or a lazy list.
idiom.skip-link: TalkBack headings cover this. Mark headings with semantics { heading() }.
